entities.summary: Udo Riglewski is a former professional tennis player from Germany. He enjoyed most of his tennis success while playing doubles. During his career he won 10 doubles titles and finished runner-up an additional 10 times. He achieved a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 6 in 1991. Udo Riglewski was a athletes & competitors from Lauffen am Neckar (b. 1966-07-28, Lauffen am Neckar). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
